title: Atalanta Fugiens
author: Michael Maier
description: Maier's polymodal emblem book: 50 emblems plus a frontispiece, each combining an engraved plate, a Latin epigram, and a polyphonic fugue. The sequence encodes the alchemical opus from prima materia to the Philosopher's Stone.
rights_note: Public domain. Images from furnaceandfugue.org and Science History Institute.

title: Hypnerotomachia Poliphili
author: Francesco Colonna
description: Aldine first edition. One of the most lavishly illustrated incunabula, containing ~172 woodcut illustrations. Classified here as alchemical reception context: the book encodes Neoplatonic, Hermetic, and architectural themes that overlap significantly with contemporary alchemical emblem traditions.
rights_note: Public domain. Images from Internet Archive (1499 Aldine edition).
